pr_title: Complete ADR 0122 spatial audio first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes ADR 0122 spatial audio first-release requirements on current main, including managed spatial voice lifecycle, ECS/runtime synchronization, Project Rust deferred controls, Editor audio Inspector/audition, and Scene View spatial gizmos.

## Validation

Run Windows affected validation and Editor Visual Validation before merge.
